notes.title: A new game that's completely free!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971989/d902104c3e6dc6015755e8c55ce716db8297e242.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hello! I want to share with you my new free game Void of Lilly![/h3][p]Long time ago, people faced the Black Fog disease. That's how Axis city became the last bastion of humanity. Years of progress within total isolation, and now it's a beautiful place, filled with advanced techologies. But you aren't really interested in all af this stuff, right? You just want to find your sister and bring her back![/p][p]This is a short story-focused game with a few JRPG elements, beautiful pixel art and BULLET HELL battles!!! Fight scenes are kinda look a bit like Undertale. The game is short 30-90 minutes of gameplay, depending on your willing to read everything and find some secrets.[/p][h3]Gamejolt page: [/h3][p][url="https://gamejolt.com/games/void_of_lilly/979291"]https://gamejolt.com/games/void_of_lilly/979291[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]itch.io page: [/h3][p][url="https://innocent-soul.itch.io/void-of-lilly"]https://innocent-soul.itch.io/void-of-lilly[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I want to make it on Steam sooner or later, but right now there are some troubles on my side, so I can only release it there...[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971989/09af55b98a4a55de894b5ae20bd553caeb7f0173.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971989/d580b3ec594a0493515d9506ec4a6b6d3fa83b36.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971989/daa6fc59f2987c74be4ed1a5ff8666cf7e603cca.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41971989/60a2e28eaf8199744edec0f558a95222a0dc4cf6.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: 1.0.2 - mostly fixes
notes.content:
[h2]This update contains some bug fixes and improvements:[/h2]
[h3]• steam IDE update (SteamDeck support)
• 1st boss became easier
• flying (act 4) became easier
• fixed: bug when slimes where vanishiing after a pause
• fixed: some hitboxes
• fixed: bossfight leaderboards
• minor design changes[/h3]

P.S. Guys, if you see any lind of bug, please report about them. It took so much time to find out there are some bugs (even critical), because they where not appearing on the testing PC.
